rate_limits: Default: 1,000 requests/hour per API key across api.data.gov. DEMO_KEY: 30 requests/IP/hour and 50 requests/IP/day. Limits may vary by service; USDA ERS publishes no separate numeric limit.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: Replace the original. The current official api.data.gov manual specifies 1,000 requests/hour by default and DEMO_KEY limits of 30/IP/hour and 50/IP/day; it says service limits may vary. ERS terms mention possible limits but publish no numeric ERS-specific limit. Evidence: https://api.data.gov/docs/developer-manual/ and https://www.ers.usda.gov/developer/api-terms-of-service
